description: Yield definition tier (STRICT/ASSUMED/BROAD/UNIT_UNRESOLVED per export.py rules; EARLY; DRY; OTHER_DEFINITION). Feature, not a filter.
1 if mass_basis == DRY (yield table).
1 if yield_scope == EARLY (yield table).
1 if flag BOX_CENTRE_ASSUMED_MEAN (box centre assumed to be a mean). Excluded from default model.
1 if flag DUPLICATE_EXCLUDED. None in this freeze.
1 if the row belongs to the default model table (no boxplot; biomass: last timepoint per group).
Biomass: measurement signature with the timepoint removed.
Biomass: group of the same contrast measured at several timepoints.
Biomass: number of timepoints available for the group.
Biomass: 1 for the last timepoint of the group (terminal first, then max days).
Sampling variance of lnRR as delivered in the freeze (may include USER_ASSUMED_SE). Untouched.
Bias-corrected lnRR as delivered in the freeze (only where SD known).
Group n; missing n replaced by the median n of the endpoint table (flag N_IMPUTED_MEDIAN).
1 if n was imputed.
CV (sd/mean) used for the variance of each group.
AUTHOR_SD (authors' SD/SE, SOURCE_REPORTED) | STUDY_PRINTED_CV_PCT (study ANOVA CV%) | STUDY_PRINTED_LSD | IMPUTED_MEAN_CV (pooled CV-bar, NOT reported by authors).
var(lnRR) = CV_t^2/n_t + CV_c^2/n_c with own CV where author SD exists, else study CV%/LSD, else CV-bar (Nakagawa et al. 2023 mixed approach).
var(lnRR) using CV-bar for every group (Nakagawa et al. 2023 method 1), sensitivity only.
Bias-corrected lnRR: lnRR + 0.5*(CV_t^2/n_t - CV_c^2/n_c) using cv_used and n_imp.
1 if both groups have author SD/SE and reported n (no imputation of any kind).
JSON list: VARIANCE_IMPUTED_MEAN_CV, VARIANCE_FROM_STUDY_CV_PCT, VARIANCE_FROM_STUDY_LSD, N_IMPUTED_MEDIAN, USER_ASSUMED_SE_NOT_USED_FOR_VARIANCE, INDEPENDENT_ARMS_ASSUMED_FOR_VARIANCE.
AUTHOR_SD_SE | IMPUTED_MEAN_CV | STUDY_PRINTED_CV_OR_LSD_OR_N_IMPUTED.
Sample-size weight n_t*n_c/(n_t+n_c) (imputed n where missing).
lnRR of S vs C for the matching stressed control arm (0 for B_vs_C). META-REGRESSION MODERATOR ONLY. Never an ML feature (post-stress outcome).
1 for contrasts without stress (B vs C).
stress_code; NONE for B_vs_C.
is_terminal_t.
Publication year as number (descriptive only, not a feature).

Primary biostimulant category after du Jardin (2015): HUMIC_FULVIC, PROTEIN_N, SEAWEED_BOTANICAL, CHITOSAN_BIOPOLYMER, INORGANIC, BENEFICIAL_FUNGI, BENEFICIAL_BACTERIA; MIXTURE if >1; OTHER_NON_DUJARDIN; UNCLASSIFIED. Regex over f_biostimulant_class/bio_code/f_microorganism/f_composition/f_strain.
Multi-hot du Jardin categories (a product can belong to several).
Harmonised dose unit class (CFU, MOLAR_mM, MOLAR_uM, CONC_gL_or_mLL, PER_PLANT_OR_POT, PER_AREA, PER_SOIL_MASS, UNKNOWN, NOT_REPORTED).
log10 of dose on the canonical scale of its class (mg/L->g/L, uM->mM, 1 % = 10 g/L).
Dose rescaled 0..1 within study and dose class (design only).
Harmonised stress class (NONE, SALINITY, DROUGHT, HEAT, COLD, NUTRIENT, HEAVY_METAL, BIOTIC, ...).
Design-based relative stress intensity: salinity NaCl-equivalent mM / 200 (EC dS/m*10; 1 % w/v = 171 mM); drought 1 - FC/100; NONE = 0. Never uses an outcome.
Within-study dense rank of the stress level / max rank (0..1).
NaCl-equivalent concentration (mM), salinity only.
Tomato market group from f_fruit_type/f_cultivar: CHERRY_COCKTAIL, PROCESSING, BEEF_LARGE, ROUND_FRESH_MARKET, UNSPECIFIED.
DETERMINATE / SEMI_DETERMINATE / INDETERMINATE / UNSPECIFIED.
HYBRID / OP_CULTIVAR_LINE / UNSPECIFIED.
Growing system: FIELD / GREENHOUSE / CHAMBER / SOILLESS / UNSPECIFIED.
1 if grown in pots/bags/containers.
Application route: FOLIAR / SEED / ROOT_DIP / FERTIGATION / SOIL_SUBSTRATE / UNSPECIFIED.
Number of applications (numeric f_n_applications).

du Jardin class v2: cell-free filtrates -> DJ_MICROBIAL_DERIVED_NONLIVING; single-component preparations take the first-named category; MIXTURE only for >=2 components (db_arms.n_bio_components) spanning >=2 categories.
Number of biostimulant components of the treated arm (db_arms.n_bio_components).
1 if the product contains living microorganisms (0 for cell-free filtrates/extracts).
1 for cell-free filtrates, supernatants, microbial water extracts.
FIELD_CAPACITY_PCT | ETC_OR_IRRIGATION_PCT | UNKNOWN_TYPE (drought, not reported) | NOT_APPLICABLE (not drought).
Water supply of the drought treatment by measurement type; 100 when not drought (no deficit); NaN = drought, not reported.
Within drought rows only: 1 reported, 0 not reported; NaN = not applicable.
NACL_CONCENTRATION | EC_WATER_MEASURED | NACL_AND_EC | UNKNOWN_TYPE | NOT_APPLICABLE.
NaCl concentration (mM; % w/v*171.1; g/L*17.11) and measured irrigation-water EC (dS/m) kept separate; 0 when not saline.
Within salinity rows only: 1 reported, 0 not; NaN = not applicable.
Stress duration in days (weeks*7, months*30.4, h/24); 0 when no stress; NaN = not reported.
Within stressed rows: 1/0; NaN for no-stress rows.
Days between first application and stress onset (unit converted); NaN without stress.
Development phase: SEED, NURSERY_SEEDLING, TRANSPLANT, VEGETATIVE, FLOWERING, FRUITING, MULTIPLE_STAGES, UNSPECIFIED (onset: NOT_APPLICABLE without stress).
SOILLESS_INERT, PEAT_POTTING_MIX, STERILISED_SOIL, SAND_OR_SANDY, FIELD_OR_NATURAL_SOIL, UNSPECIFIED.
Soil EC normalised to dS/m (uS/cm / 1000).
Plants per m2: printed value, plants/ha / 10000, plants per plot area, or 1/(row x plant spacing). Range-checked 0.2-40.
Provenance of the density value (F_PLANT_DENSITY_M2, PLANTS_PER_HA, PLANTS_PER_PLOT_AREA, SPACING_GEOMETRY, PRINTED_PER_M2).
REPORTED_OR_DERIVED | NOT_APPLICABLE_POTS | NOT_REPORTED.
